# Service level and delivery policy

* [Resolution targets](/policies/resolution-targets.md) - working-time resolution targets for Bug and Incident tickets, by priority.
* [How a target breach is counted](/policies/breach-counting.md) - counting rules for target breaches, including scope and exclusions.
* [Escalation matrix](/policies/escalation-matrix.md) - who is notified when a ticket breaches its resolution target.
* [SOP Penanganan Permintaan Layanan IT](/policies/SOP-Layanan-IT.docx) - SLA dan alur eskalasi untuk permintaan layanan IT (Service Request). Dokumen sumber, format `.docx`.


# Definitions

* [Waiting time versus working time](/definitions/duration-basis.md) - the two durations a ticket carries, and which one policy targets are measured on.

# Directories

* [policies/](policies/) - service level policy, targets, and escalation.
* [definitions/](definitions/) - shared definitions used by the policies above.
